release.release_notes:
GaiaOS 0.4.8-beta.3

Source: 43d47bb267e3780e406f364f53027d032f4bf4f2

Fresh Debian 13 amd64 launcher/application build including the corrected installer
QML handlers and QML syntax validation. The old rejected bundle was not used.
Includes the current source integration for GPU compatibility, the graphical
installer and full-system updates; the application package does not install an
OS image, firmware, an A/B layout or privileged system provisioning.

Checks passed: 61 Python cases, 19 QML syntax checks, ShellCheck, native Qt 6.8.2
build and four CTest suites (62 native cases). Installer welcome rendered under
Xvfb/Mesa. Full native UI probes passed with persistent Xvfb and core X11 input
(QT_XCB_NO_XI2=1), keeping auto-repeat enabled. The default Xvfb input path showed
repeat-event/timing failures; no production input workaround was added.

VM/hardware acceptance remains pending Chris. No ISO, system bundle or disk image
is attached. Full-system installation/reboot/rollback still needs separate signed
media, trust provisioning and acceptance. Stable remains unchanged.
